project_context.name: FreshBoard.lol
project_context.vibe: Dark, neon, brutalist, meme-y, competitive-auction. A high-energy financial ticker meets a rebellious product launch board.

primary.usage: Hero headers, Countdown Timer, Rank Numbers (#1, #2), and massive Bid Amounts ($150). Apply tracking-tighter.

secondary.usage: Card titles, product names, section headers.

mono.usage: Taglines, category chips, standard body text, input fields, data labels, ticker tapes.

typography.import_instructions: Import 'Unbounded', 'Outfit', and 'JetBrains Mono' from Google Fonts.

background.description: Deepest void black. No pure whites or grays without intention.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px sharp, solid borders (border-[#262626]). Emphasize the grid layout heavily, like a technical terminal.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard, flat neo-brutalist shadows if needed (e.g., 4px 4px 0px #EC4899), or glowing neon drop-shadows (drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(234,179,8,0.5)]) for the #1 rank.
visual_enhancers.textures: CSS noise overlay on the main background to eliminate digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Retro-Futurism 'Terminal' look and Grid Borders patterns. Flat solid surfaces, NO soft glassmorphism unless strictly for the sticky nav.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous inner padding for structural elements (p-6, p-8), but tightly packed grid items (gap-0 or gap-4 with borders).
grids_and_layouts.leaderboard_grid: The Bento Protocol (High Density). Desktop: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3. The #1 Ranked Card MUST span col-span-full or at least 2 columns and be visually distinct.
grids_and_layouts.hero_section: Massive typography. A centered or heavily asymmetric countdown timer displaying 'RESET IN 04:12:30'.
grids_and_layouts.marquee: Use a fast-moving Kinetic Texture marquee (react-fast-marquee) across the top or bottom showing live fictional/recent bids.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Hovering on a card should slightly lift it (-translate-y-1) and change its border color to an accent (e.g., hover:border-hot_pink).
motion_and_interactions.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular buttons. On active/click, they should compress (scale-95).
motion_and_interactions.outbid_cta: The Outbid button must be highly visible on every card, using a striking contrasting color (like Hot Pink or Cyber Yellow) with JetBrains Mono font.

component_instructions.tech_stack: React (Vite), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lucide React (or Phosphor Icons), Radix/Shadcn.
component_instructions.file_extension: Use .js and .jsx ONLY. Do NOT use .tsx or .ts files.
component_instructions.shadcn: Heavily strip standard Shadcn styles. Remove the standard border-radius, make inputs completely square with 1px borders. Use Sonner for toasts (dark mode, neon borders).
component_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn components for Dialogs (Outbid Modal) and Forms (Submission Modal). Inputs must have high focus contrast (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-hot_pink).
component_instructions.tabs: The Products vs. Social Promotions switch should be massive, blocky tabs, acting like segmented controls in a financial app.

media_and_images.strategy: Images should feel dark, edgy, and high-tech.
media_and_images.icons_library: phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react. Keep them sharp and consistent.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure the bright neon text meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio against the black background.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, tabs, inputs, modals, outbid CTAs) MUST have a descriptive 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='outbid-button-rank-1').
accessibility_and_testing.reduced_motion: Wrap complex animations in a media query or framer-motion's safe environment to respect prefers-reduced-motion.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.1: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.2: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.3: You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions instead.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.4: You MUST NOT center align the entire app container.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.5: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for sticky headers or dropdowns. Always provide a solid base or blurred background.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.6: NEVER use placeholder text (like 'Company Logo' or generic gray squares) for images; use the provided image URLs.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.7: Do not build UI components from scratch if Shadcn equivalents exist (like Select, Dialog).
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.8: Use .js extensions for all files. No TypeScript.
